parameters.content:
## Classify three items
Three input items produce three model requests, one at a time. Expected labels in order: positive, negative, neutral. Prompts use each input item; the model ID stays constant because model sub-node expressions may resolve against the first item.

For the installed Cortecs package. Set your credential and model on every Cortecs node. Real requests may incur charges.

parameters.jsCode: return ['I love this product!', 'This product is awful.', 'The package arrived on Tuesday.'].map(review => ({ json: { review } }));

parameters.text: ={{ 'Classify sentiment as exactly positive, negative, or neutral. Output only the label. Review: ' + $json.review }}
